bugs.criterion: Mobile accessibility and interaction quality are acceptable
bugs.evidence: Browser check mobile-accessibility-no-overflow passed no-horizontal-scroll and accessible controls, but after clicking mobile-menu-toggle the nav remained hidden at 390px (class desktop-nav is-open; CSS only displays nav at min-width 700px).

action_items: Fix mobile open-menu styling so .desktop-nav.is-open is visible below the 700px breakpoint; preserve accessible navigation links.

checks.criterion: Home storefront loads with mobile-first luxury shell, announcement, navigation, hero CTA, featured fragrances, scent finder, review and news sections
checks.name: home-storefront-shell
checks.evidence: Rerun passed at 390x844: home hero, MAKE MY PERFUME wordmark, Explore collection CTA, seeded Citrus Noir, scent finder, review and news sections visible. Initial attempt only failed due unsupported toHaveScreenshot usage; screenshot captured on rerun.

checks.criterion: Collections support seeded product discovery, live search, mood filters, sorting, and product detail navigation
checks.name: collection-search-filter-detail
checks.evidence: Rerun passed: Citrus Noir visible, search narrows away Amber Veil, Fresh filter works, product detail shows image, 4.9 rating/128 reviews, notes accordion and Buy now control. Initial note selector was too strict.

checks.criterion: Guest cart supports add-to-cart drawer, quantity controls, removal, and persistence
checks.name: guest-cart-drawer-persistence
checks.evidence: Passed at 390x844: add opens drawer, count is 1, increment/decrement update quantity, close/reopen retains item, remove returns empty cart.

checks.criterion: Buy-now and cart checkout reach a guest checkout without login
checks.name: guest-checkout-reachable
checks.evidence: Rerun passed: Citrus Noir Buy now reaches checkout with name, email, Indian phone/address/city/state/PIN fields and prepaid/COD options. Initial failure used incorrect product-buy-now test id.

checks.criterion: Checkout pricing is transparent and updates by payment method
checks.name: checkout-transparent-pricing
checks.evidence: Rerun passed: GST (18%), prepaid savings ₹120, COD handling fee ₹80 and switching payment methods are visible for ₹1,200 Citrus Noir. Initial failures were selector/test-id assumptions.

checks.criterion: Valid guest prepaid order completes through the payment boundary
checks.name: guest-prepaid-order-confirmation
checks.evidence: Rerun passed: valid guest details submit to confirmation with MMP reference and exact payment confirmed in demo mode message. Initial failure used incorrect Buy now test id and then a non-unique demo text matcher.

checks.criterion: News, About, Contact, policies, and newsletter surfaces are reachable and usable
checks.name: content-contact-newsletter-policies
checks.evidence: Rerun passed: contact short-message validation and valid success state work; footer News and Privacy navigate to content routes. Initial failures were native form validation and incorrect policy test id.

checks.criterion: Mobile accessibility and interaction quality are acceptable
checks.name: mobile-accessibility-no-overflow
checks.evidence: At 390x844 document scroll width does not overflow and menu/cart controls have accessible names, but clicking Open menu leaves main-navigation hidden despite is-open class. Reproduced on initial run and rerun.

checks.criterion: Collections support seeded product discovery, live search, mood filters, sorting, and product detail navigation
checks.name: backend-catalog
checks.evidence: pytest HTTP assertions passed: GET /api/products?search=Citrus%20Noir 200 with seeded ₹1,200 item; Fresh filter and GET /api/products/citrus-noir 200; missing slug 404.

checks.criterion: Checkout pricing is transparent and updates by payment method; valid guest prepaid order completes through payment boundary
checks.name: backend-commerce
checks.evidence: pytest HTTP assertions passed: POST /api/checkout/preview returns subtotal 1200, GST 194.4, prepaid discount 120, free shipping and total 1274.4; COD fee 80; POST /api/orders/mock returns mocked payment_confirmed and idempotent duplicate; invalid PIN 422.

checks.criterion: News, About, Contact, policies, and newsletter surfaces are reachable and usable
checks.name: backend-content
checks.evidence: pytest HTTP assertions passed: GET /api/news and detail 200; POST /api/subscribers and POST /api/contact 200; short contact message 422.
